title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to teach us the Qur’an in every state, except when he was in a state of Janābah (major ritual impurity)
hadeeth: ‘Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to teach us the Qur’an in every state, except when he was in a state of Janābah (major ritual impurity).
attribution: Narrated by Abu Dāwūd, At-Tirmidhi, An-Nasā’i, Ibn Mājah, and Ahmad
explanation: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to teach and recite the Qur’an to his Companions in all conditions, except when he was in a state of Janābah due to marital relations with his wives.
hints: It is impermissible for one in a state of Janābah to recite the Qur’an until he makes Ghusl (ritual bath).
hadeeth_intro: ‘Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadeeth_ar: عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُقْرِئُنَا القُرْآنَ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ جُنُبًا.
hadeeth_intro_ar: عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ
explanation_ar: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يعلم أصحابه القرآن ويُقرئهم إياه على كل أحواله ما لم يكن على جنابة من جماع أهله.
hints_ar: عدم جواز قراءة الجنب للقرآن حتى يغتسل.
attribution_ar: رواه أبو داود والترمذي والنسائي وابن ماجه وأحمد
